verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS platform like Glama, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not document any setting to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The nearest items do not qualify: 'private by default' covers server listing visibility, and the Gateway logging every call is the opposite of opting out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
